key_decisions.decision: Render cornerstones as leaders while retaining assembly and exact count.
Retain the narrator’s murdered designation and begin the husband’s own account.
Preserve his claim about intended murder and his omission of handing her over, without harmonizing chapter 19.
Keep his admitted action and stated justification.
Retain the terse lot procedure without inventing what exactly the lot selects.
Render tribes within Benjamin as clans and retain the accusation.
Preserve the requested punishment and purge formula, with refusal by kin.
Retain left-handedness and the hyperbolic precision, with the literal right-hand expression noted.
Keep the first inquiry about order, not a promise of victory.
Keep the singular collective voice, brother language and command without added victory promise.
Preserve the parenthetic ark notice across the verse boundary.
Keep full priestly lineage, brother language and the first explicit dated victory promise.
Preserve both named routes, open-country setting and approximate casualties; note uncertain geography.
Keep the two forces and difficult terrain phrase with alternatives noted.
Mark the retrospective explanation naturally without deleting the repeated account.
Retain the compressed second movement and total scope of attack.
Read turned as the feigned retreat here, with the other turn in 41, and retain the repeated thirty.
Retain rising smoke and the whole-town image without introducing a new battle.
Preserve the difficult plural towns and unspecified attackers, with alternatives noted.
Retain the uncertain rest expression and eastward endpoint without forcing a place name.
Retain the gleaning metaphor, both loss figures and named destinations.
Keep this summary figure without silently harmonizing verse 35.
Preserve indiscriminate destruction beyond the army, with the difficult whole-town phrase noted.
